The word '''moon''' can refer to the following:

==Animals==
*[[Moonflower]] - a [[horse]] owned by [[Leane Sharif]].
*[[Moonglow]] - a horse owned by [[Joline Maza]].
*[[Moonlight]] - a horse ridden by [[Nynaeve al'Meara]].
*[[Two Moons]] - a [[wolf]] pack leader

==[[Sword forms]]==
*[[Moon on the Water]]
*[[Moon Rises Over the Lakes]]
*[[Moon Rises Over Water]]

==Seanchan==
*[[Court of the Nine Moons]] - the seat of power in the [[Seanchan]] empire.
*[[Daughter of the Nine Moons]] - the title of the heir of the [[Crystal Throne]].

==Others==
*[[Nesta din Reas Two Moons]] - former [[Mistress of the Ships]] of the ''[[Atha'an Miere]].''
*[[Feast of the Half Moon]] - a feastday on the [[Taisham 23|23rd day]] of [[Taisham]].
*[[Half-moon axe]] - A weapon carried by [[Perrin Aybara]]
*''[[Knife of Dreams/Chapter 31|The House on Full Moon Street]]'' - the thirty-first chapter of ''[[Knife of Dreams]]''.
*[[Golden crescents]] - a ''[[ter'angreal]]'' that is part of [[Cadsuane Melaidhrin]]'s [[paralis-net]] that look like moons.
